g.text: Large marker = last checkpoint. On code, LoRA has the better trade-off (less forgetting for the same score); on math, full fine-tuning does.

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; text-anchor: end; fill: #86868b

g.text: Data: Biderman et al. 2024 (LoRA Learns Less and Forgets Less), Tables S1–S8, Llama-2-7B; source score = mean of HellaSwag, ARC-C, WinoGrande
